stemMd: An angle lies strictly in the second quadrant. Which sign combination is correct?
explanationMd: On the unit circle in quadrant two, y is positive and x negative. Sine is the y-coordinate and cosine the x-coordinate, so their signs are positive and negative respectively.

distractorRationale.e: Sine is zero only on an axis, excluded here.
